scripts.build: npm run build -w @compasso/domain && npm run build -w @compasso/api && npm run build -w @compasso/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @compasso/domain && npm run build -w @compasso/api && npm run typecheck -w @compasso/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @compasso/domain && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:watch: npm run build -w @compasso/domain && npm run test:watch -w @compasso/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w @compasso/web
